crossRefs.note: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters…
There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces.…
These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of…
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
“Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of…
When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;
because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy…
Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more…
Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should…

people.name: Meribah
people.line: A place where Moses disobeyed God

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
translations.bsb: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
translations.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses
translations.asv: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
